name: Overqwil
description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.description: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Harden
moves.description: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to boost its Defense stat.

moves.name: Bite
moves.description: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fell Stinger
moves.description: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.description: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply boosts its evasiveness.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Brine
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the target's HP is at half or less.

moves.name: Barb Barrage
moves.description: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.description: The user stores power and boosts its Defense and Sp. Def stats. This move can be used up to three times.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.description: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Acupressure
moves.description: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.description: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.description: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.description: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.description: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard
moves.description: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Agility
moves.description: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.

moves.name: Haze
moves.description: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.description: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user hurls unsanitary sludge at the target to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will damage opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.description: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally splits the combined HP between the target and itself.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.description: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Mud Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Poison Tail
moves.description: The user hits the target with its tail. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also poison the target.

moves.name: Gyro Ball
moves.description: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Toxic Spikes
moves.description: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Dark Pulse
moves.description: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Venoshock
moves.description: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

moves.name: Sludge Wave
moves.description: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.

moves.name: Throat Chop
moves.description: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.

moves.name: Smart Strike
moves.description: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Liquidation
moves.description: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.description: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.description: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's stats were lowered during this turn.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Chilling Water
moves.description: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
